description: Source code for the 'clar' testing framework, including core test functions, error handling, suite execution, argument parsing, and platform-specific timing functions.

classes.name: clar_error
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during a test, including file, function, line, message, and description.

classes.name: clar_explicit
classes.description: Represents an explicit test suite or test filter configuration.

classes.name: clar_report
classes.description: Contains information about individual test execution reports, including status, errors, and timing.

classes.name: clar_summary
classes.description: Holds summary information for test results, including filename and file pointer.

classes.name: clar_func
classes.description: Defines a test function with a name and function pointer.

classes.name: clar_suite
classes.description: Defines a test suite with name, initialization, cleanup, list of tests, and enabled status.

methods.name: clar_abort
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by printing message and exiting.

methods.name: clar_time_now
methods.description: Gets current time for timing measurements, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_time_diff
methods.description: Calculates difference between two time points, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_run_test
methods.description: Runs an individual test, handling setup, execution, and teardown.

methods.name: clar_run_suite
methods.description: Runs all tests in a suite, applying filters and handling reporting.

methods.name: clar_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the test runner.

methods.name: clar_parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for test configuration.

methods.name: clar_test_init
methods.description: Initializes test environment, processes arguments, and prepares reporting.

methods.name: clar_test_run
methods.description: Executes all configured test suites and tests.

methods.name: clar_test_shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, writes summaries, and frees resources.

methods.name: clar_test
methods.description: Main entry point for running tests, combining init, run, and shutdown.

methods.name: abort_test
methods.description: Handles critical failures during test execution, performing longjmp if needed.
